notes: Declaring the prelude value name `panic` is diagnosed as E-RES-CONFLICT by the implementation (prelude names are reserved). Honest caveat: diagnostics.md §3.2 defines E-RES-CONFLICT as an import colliding with a local declaration or an ambiguous import, and modules.md MOD-3.2/MOD-3.7 assign those scenarios other codes (DUPLICATE) or none; the prelude-collision trigger, the only emitter of E-RES-CONFLICT, is not described in spec/language. The mismatch is reported.
